analytics_options.summary_template: Issue {{ data.issue }} went to {{ data.subscribers }} subscribers on {{ data.sent_on }}; {{ data.open_rate_pct }}% opened it.
analytics_options.highlights_template: [{% for row in data.most_read[:limit] %}{"label": {{ row.title|tojson }}, "url": {{ row.url|tojson }}}{% if not loop.last %},{% endif %}{% endfor %}]

options.summary_template: {{ data.published|length }} things went up or changed since {{ data.since }}.
options.items_template: [{% for row in data.published %}{"label": {{ row.title|tojson }}, "url": {{ row.url|tojson }}, "note": {{ row.note|tojson }}}{% if not loop.last %},{% endif %}{% endfor %}]

options.summary_template: Rising over the last {{ data.window_days }} days: {% for row in data.rising[:3] %}"{{ row.query }}" ({{ row.volume }}/mo, {{ row.change_pct }}% up){% if not loop.last %}, {% endif %}{% endfor %}.
options.items_template: [{% for row in data.rising %}{"label": {{ row.query|tojson }}, "volume": {{ row.volume }}, "change_pct": {{ row.change_pct }}}{% if not loop.last %},{% endif %}{% endfor %}]

brand_description: Sproutly sells indoor gardening kits — grow lights, self-watering planters, and starter herb sets — and publishes guides for people growing food in small apartments.
agent_goal: Keep the people already on the list growing things successfully, and send them back to the guides and kits that answer what they are stuck on this month.
